# Pi ZK NFT Gate — llms.txt
# A read-only capability probe and design document for zero-knowledge-gated NFT
# access on Pi Network.

> This repository PROBES what the current Pi RPC exposes for ZK-related
> capabilities and DOCUMENTS the design of a gate that grants access on proof of
> a predicate without revealing the underlying identity.
> It does NOT assert that a ZK gate is deployed on Pi today.

## What it is
- read-only, zero-dependency, Node (ESM), Node >= 18
- zk-gate.mjs: the CLI (--probe --design --offline --network --rpc)
- test.mjs: 12 offline checks (node --test; --probe --offline skips every
  network call)
- never writes; no database; no API keys

## The two things it does
1. Probe — query the live RPC and report which methods respond, so the boundary
   between "protocol supports it" and "RPC exposes it" is MEASURED, not assumed.
2. Design — a written design covering predicate, witness, proof, verifier
   contract, and the trust boundary between them.

## Measured RPC surface (2026-10-19, protocol 28)
OK: getHealth (includes ledgerRetentionWindow: 120960), getNetwork (Pi Testnet,
protocol 28), getLatestLedger, getLedgers, getEvents (endLedger exclusive;
filters accept only "system"/"contract"), getTransactions, getFeeStats,
getTransaction (unknown hashes -> status NOT_FOUND).
Method not found: getLedger, getContractData.
No method in the probe list takes or verifies a ZK proof. ZK capabilities are
exercised INSIDE Soroban contracts, not through the RPC surface.

Mainnet: there is no public Soroban RPC. rpc.mainnet.minepi.com and
soroban-rpc.mainnet.minepi.com both answer HTTP 503 and serve a certificate that
expired 2023-05-30. api.mainnet.minepi.com is REST (Horizon), not JSON-RPC.

## Trust boundary
- Prover: holds the private witness; can choose to prove, or not
- Verifier contract: holds public inputs + verification key; deterministically
  accepts or rejects
- Setup: circuit-specific trusted setup (if any) — a critical trust assumption
  that must be documented per circuit
The gate proves A PREDICATE HOLDS, not WHO the person is.

## Usage
- node zk-gate.mjs --probe                 (read-only, testnet)
- node zk-gate.mjs --probe --offline       (method list, no network)
- node zk-gate.mjs --probe --rpc <url>
- node zk-gate.mjs --design
- node --test test.mjs
Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 no mode; 2 refused (--probe --network mainnet without --rpc).

## Not claimed
- that a ZK gate is deployed on Pi today (this repo is a probe and a design)
- that BN254 / Poseidon are exposed through the RPC surface (the probe measures
  what the RPC returns; the capability lives inside Soroban contracts)
- that any specific circuit is secure (circuit design and trusted setup are out
  of scope)
- that the method list is permanent (it is an observation on 2026-10-19)
- that Pi Network has adopted, reviewed or endorsed this
